sentences: During a trip, try not to take every dark thought that comes up as the truth about you.
It's often just the flip side of whatever you've been focusing on, and pushing it away tends to make it come back stronger.
You can tell the person sitting with you, but maybe hold off on confessing it to everybody else, since a trip is about the worst time to decide something is permanently wrong with you.
Just notice what's there, maybe saying to yourself, "OK, there's a thought, and there's a feeling, and it's intense, but it's not all of me."
Then come back to the room you're in, your body, the person with you, what time it is, and love.
